speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development whether the Ministry has plans to introduce the Development Support and Learning Support programmes to non-Anchor Operator preschools.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Pre-school operators with a critical mass of centres, such as the Anchor Operators or AOPs, are DS-LS providers in their centres with their own in-house Learning Support Educators.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: Pre-schools that are interested to offer the DS-LS programme can contact the regional DS-LS providers to learn more about the DS-LS programme and for assistance to screen children with suspected developmental delays for early intervention support.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Could I just ask whether we are aware of what is the number and the percentage of children who are differently-abled or who are in pre-schools that do not offer this DS-LS programme.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: The second point, I think that there are some that are out there, who are in these schools that do not offer the DS-LS programme.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I am wondering whether ECDA is watching this space and seeing how we can support these children.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Because I am worried that without the DS-LS programme, it really will be detrimental to their development.
